caveats: Two official Indian sources give different figures for the Indian origin population in Israel and for Indian citizens there. Both are shown rather than one being chosen.

Maps use the India point of view geodata published by amCharts. India is drawn as the Government of India depicts it, including Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh and Aksai Chin. Several of those boundaries are disputed internationally and other governments publish different depictions. This project does not draw or adjust any boundary itself.
Community origin traditions are labelled as community claims throughout, which records the type of evidence and is not a comment on the community.
